Problem Statement:
Given a number n followed by n numbers Print the index 2nd largest number in an array (1 base index) 
Input Description:
0<n<100
Given a number n
Followed by n number in next line 
Output Description:
Print the largest number index in an array 
Explanation:
6 is the size of an array
[5,7,4,4,6,8] from this array, 7 is the second largest number and its position on the array is 2. 
Sample Input:
6
5 7 4 4 6 8 
Sample Output:
2
